site.title: Kestrel Loop | Software and back-office teams in Da Nang
site.description: Kestrel Loop runs software, QA and accounting teams in Da Nang for product companies and accounting firms in the US, the UK and Australia.

data.title: Software and accounting teams in *Da Nang*
data.lead: Kestrel Loop builds web products, tests releases and keeps the books for companies in the US, the UK and Australia, with 140 staff in one Da Nang office.

slides.label: One Da Nang office, clients on three continents

photo.alt: Two engineers reviewing a pull request together
Accountant reconciling a ledger on a laptop

head.title: Our services
head.lead: Four service lines run from the same office, so one account manager can staff a product squad and a bookkeeping desk under one contract.

cards.title: Product squads for web and mobile apps
cards.text: Squads of four to eight engineers build React, Node and Flutter products, join your sprint rituals and hand over code in your own repositories.
bullets: Design and QA inside the squad

cards.title: Release testing for weekly deploys
cards.text: Testers write the regression suite with your team, automate it in Playwright and run it on every release candidate before it reaches users.

photo.alt: QA engineers going through a test run on a large screen

cards.title: Bookkeeping and payroll for accounting firms
cards.text: Accountants close the books in QuickBooks and Xero for your clients, prepare payroll runs and send every file through a reviewer before it leaves the desk.
bullets: Monthly close in QuickBooks and Xero

photo.alt: Accounting documents and a calculator on a desk

cards.title: Data entry, cleanup and document processing
cards.text: Operators extract, check and load invoice, order and claim data into your systems, with daily counts and error rates in a shared sheet.

photo.alt: Operator processing documents on a laptop

head.title: Who does what in each model
head.lead: Pick an engagement model to see which tasks stay with your team and which ones Kestrel Loop runs.

models.name: Dedicated squad
models.title: A squad that works only on your product
models.text: We hire the squad to your stack and manage its people matters. You set the roadmap and priorities, and the squad lead plans sprints with your product owner.
bullets: Scale by one person at a time

models.name: Fixed-scope project
models.fit: A defined build with a deadline
models.title: One price for an agreed scope
models.text: After a paid discovery week we agree the scope, milestones and price. Kestrel Loop plans, builds and tests the release and hands it over with documentation.

models.name: Team extension
models.title: Specialists who join your own team
models.text: Engineers or accountants work inside your team and tools and report to your managers. Kestrel Loop employs them and handles payroll, equipment and the office.

data.note: Sample split. The contract lists the final responsibilities for each engagement.

head.title: Who we work with
head.lead: Most clients are software companies and accounting firms; the rest come from logistics, health and retail.

items.title: Accounting firms

items.title: Logistics
items.text: Order data processing and dispatch tools for freight and delivery companies.
